text:
Ethan (People Ops): Quick update: two small policy items rolling out today — 1) paid jury duty clarification (how pay interacts with PTO); 2) PTO donation pilot for team hardship requests. TL;DR: jury duty is paid and does not require using PTO; if you choose to use PTO instead of jury pay, you can but it's optional. PTO donation pilot lets employees donate up to 5 days to a pooled hardship bank per year (voluntary, anonymous donations). Full details + forms: https://intranet.redwood/people/jury-pto-donation-2026 :book:

Maya (People Ops): Clarify on jury duty: managers should mark folks as "on jury" in the HR modal so benefits and pay are adjusted automatically. If your jury service spans >10 business days, People Ops will work with Payroll for any ad hoc arrangements.

Priya (Finance): Operational note: jury pay from the court is considered external income — standard payroll rules apply. If you take jury pay and also take PTO for the same days, payroll will reconcile; generally you should not double-dip. If in doubt, ask Payroll (cc Priya).

Lena (Legal): Legal confirms employers must allow time for jury duty; Redwood continues paid coverage for full-time employees. Contractors should check contract terms; typically unpaid.

Ibrahim (Eng): For remote folks called for jury duty, any impact on oncall? I might be on rotation that week.

Maya (People Ops): Good Q  treat as excused absence and work with your oncall rotation owner to swap. If you can't swap, contact People Ops and we'll help arrange temporary coverage. We don't expect people to handle oncall while serving jury duty.

Ethan (People Ops): PTO donation pilot details: employees can donate whole days (no fractional days) up to 5 days/year into a hardship pool. Recipients are approved by People Ops & HRBP; donations are anonymous to recipients. Eligibility for receiving: full-time employees with documented hardship (medical/family disaster). Donations expire after 12 months if unused and are returned to a community fund we maintain for future crises. Link to donate: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-donate

Priya (Finance): Donations are processed as PTO transfers — donors lose the day from their balance immediately; recipients get credited after approval. We'll keep an audit trail for payroll but names remain masked in the recipient-facing notice. Expect processing within 2 pay cycles.

Ibrahim (Eng): If I donate, can I earmark it to a specific person? 

Maya (People Ops): No  to keep it fair and private we only allow pool donations, not directed gifts. If you want to help someone directly, coordinate outside payroll but be mindful of company gifting policies. 

HRBot: PTO donation form live: `/hr donate` and `/hr status` show pool balance. See intranet for FAQ.

Lena (Legal): Note: international regulations differ. Donations are currently open to employees in the US, UK, and select EU countries (see policy page). We're evaluating expansion.

Ethan (People Ops): We'll host a 30-min Q&A tomorrow 11am PT to walk through the forms and jury pay reconciliation examples. If you have pre-scheduled jury service or need immediate assistance, DM Maya or open a ticket. We'll pin the policy doc after the session. :pushpin:
